title: GEMglDrawBuffer
description: specify which color buffers are to be drawn into

messages.description: up to four color buffers to be drawn into

arguments.description: up to four color buffers to be drawn into

body: [GEMglDrawBuffer] calls glDrawBuffer() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. Its creation arguments also take GL constants by name; its inlets only take their values. See glDrawBuffer in the OpenGL reference.
